description: Current floor price in SOL for up to 10 collections, read from MAGIC EDEN ONLY - it takes Magic Eden symbols and returns Magic Eden rows, with no other marketplace and no other currency, whether or not an OpenSea key is configured. For a cross-marketplace floor comparison use get_collection_stats, which quotes each marketplace in its own currency and refuses to compare across them. Use search_collections first if you only know a human name.
name: get_floor_prices
title: Floor prices (Magic Eden only)
